# AIMA foreign-resident stock reports and revisions, 2023–2025

The [Agência para a Integração, Migrações e Asilo
(AIMA)](https://aima.gov.pt/pt/a-aima/relatorios-de-migracoes-e-asilo)
publishes annual migration and asylum reports. Its original and subsequent
administrative vintages are **different observations of a changing
definition**, not a single silently comparable 2017–2025 time series.

## Documented vintages

| Source | Reporting role |
| --- | --- |
| [RMA 2023](https://aima.gov.pt/media/pages/documents/92dd0f02ea-1726562672/rma-2023.pdf) | Original year-end 2023 foreign-resident stock and original nationality annex |
| [RMA 2023 erratum](https://aima.gov.pt/media/pages/documents/4ec85f5ab7-1727367154/errata-rma-2023.pdf) | Corrects source report-wide male/female subtotals |
| [August 2025 AIMA/INE comparison](https://om.aima.gov.pt/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Indicadores-Migratorios-em-Portugal_Analise-Comparativa-entre-a-AIMA-e-o-INE_v3_04082025.pdf) | Interim revised 2017–2023 totals |
| [RMA 2024](https://aima.gov.pt/media/pages/documents/fec4d6a712-1760603125/relatorio-migracoes-e-asilo-2024.pdf) | Later revised historical stock and 2024 reporting categories |
| [RMA 2025](https://aima.gov.pt/docs/Relatorio_de_Migracoes_e_Asilo_2025.pdf) | Subsequent 2025 report and nationality observations |

The downstream `empirical-analysis-r` source inventory and reporting-scope
audit retain each publication's title, publisher, reference years, revision
stage and evidence location. Examples that **must not be conflated**:

| Report basis | 2023 resident-stock figure |
| --- | ---: |
| Original RMA 2023 | 1,044,606 |
| August 2025 interim revised series | 1,293,463 |
| Later RMA 2024 revised series | 1,304,833 |

The original RMA 2023 sex totals are corrected by its erratum to **553,965
men** and **490,641 women**. The nationality annex's São Tomé and Príncipe
count (26,488) differs from the 2023 nationality summary (26,460), a
documented difference of **28**, not an error to be silently adjusted.

Later administrative series cover broader cases, including pending
regularisation, certain CPLP authorisations and temporary protection.
Retrospective changes in reported *stocks* do not measure arrivals or a
causal effect of policy. These totals cannot be treated as equivalent to
Eurostat's **1 January population by citizenship**, nor to original SEF
residence-authorisation stocks without a scope reconciliation.

**External metadata only.** The public AIMA PDFs and project-local table
transcriptions are not mirrored without an explicit rights determination.
